meaning_en: happening three occasions within one week
example_en: I go to the gym three times a week.
examples_extra: He plays tennis three times a week.
We have English classes three times a week.
note_fa: «الگوی تکرار هفتگی: three times a week؛ مثل twice a week.»

meaning_en: Washing your body in a tub of water.
example_en: I like to take a warm bath at night.
examples_extra: She had a long hot bath after the tiring journey.
The children take a bath every evening before bed.
note_fa: have a bath — حمام کردن در وان.

meaning_en: To make an effort to do something.
example_en: Don't bother to call me, I'll be home late.
examples_extra: Do not bother to call me back tonight.
The loud noise from the street bothered him.
note_fa: don't bother to do یعنی زحمت نکن.

meaning_en: clean your teeth with a brush
example_en: Remember to brush your teeth every morning.
examples_extra: You should brush your teeth twice every day.
He brushes his teeth carefully every single morning.

meaning_en: Using a bus as transport.
example_en: I go to work by bus.
examples_extra: I go to my office by bus every morning.
We travelled by bus across the whole country.
note_fa: بدون the: by bus نه by the bus.

meaning_en: Using a car as transport.
example_en: We travel by car on weekends.
examples_extra: They came to the wedding by car last week.
It is much faster to go by car.
note_fa: بدون the: by car نه by the car.

meaning_en: Using a train as transport.
example_en: He travels to London by train.
examples_extra: I go to work by train every single day.
We travelled by train from Toronto to Montreal.
note_fa: بدون the: by train نه by the train.

meaning_en: To phone a friend.
example_en: I need to call a friend after work.
examples_extra: I will call a friend tonight and ask her to join us.
When I feel lonely, I call a friend and we talk for hours.
note_fa: یعنی به دوست زنگ زدن؛ عبارت رایج و ساده‌ای است.

meaning_en: A breakfast food made from grain, eaten with milk.
example_en: I eat cereal with milk every morning.
examples_extra: She has cereal with milk every morning.
There are many kinds of cereal in the supermarket.
note_fa: غذای صبحانه؛ با شیر خورده می‌شود.

meaning_en: To talk in a friendly, informal way.
example_en: Let's have a quick chat after work.
examples_extra: We had a long chat about our holiday plans.
Come and chat with us after class.
note_fa: هم اسم هم فعل: have a chat / chat with.

meaning_en: To make your house tidy and clean.
example_en: I need to clean the house this weekend.
examples_extra: I always clean the house every Saturday morning.
We cleaned the house before the guests arrived.
note_fa: خانه را تمیز کردن؛ do the housework هم همین معناست.

meaning_en: To brush your teeth.
example_en: Remember to clean your teeth every morning.
examples_extra: You should clean your teeth twice a day.
The dentist told him to clean his teeth properly.
note_fa: مسواک زدن؛ معادل brush your teeth.

meaning_en: A person whose job is to clean.
example_en: The cleaner comes to our office every day.
examples_extra: Our office cleaner comes on Mondays and Thursdays.
We hired a new cleaner for the office.
note_fa: نظافتچی؛ do the housework با فعل do می‌آید.

meaning_en: To return to your house.
example_en: What time do you come home?
examples_extra: What time will you come home tonight?
He comes home very late after parties.
note_fa: home بعدش to نمی‌گیرد: come home.

meaning_en: To visit someone at their house.
meaning_fa: سر زدن، به خانه کسی آمدن
example_en: Why don't you come round for dinner?
examples_extra: Come round this evening for a cup of tea.
They often come round to see us at weekends.
note_fa: صمیمانه: come round یعنی «به خونه‌ی ما بیا».

meaning_en: To clean and tidy your home.
example_en: I help my mother do housework on Saturdays.
examples_extra: He helps his mother do the housework at weekends.
They do the housework together on Saturdays.
note_fa: کارهای خانه؛ do the housework با the.

meaning_en: To buy food and other things for the home.
example_en: I do the shopping every Friday afternoon.
examples_extra: I do the shopping for my grandmother every week.
Doing the shopping online saves a lot of time.
note_fa: یعنی خرید روزمره‌ی خانه؛ با go shopping (بیرون رفتن برای خرید) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To perform household chores like washing clothes.
example_en: My flatmate and I share doing the washing.
examples_extra: I do the washing and ironing on Saturday mornings.
Doing the washing takes less time with a good machine.
note_fa: etc. مخفف et cetera است و یعنی «و غیره».

meaning_en: It does not cause trouble or worry.
example_en: The noise from outside doesn't bother me.
examples_extra: It doesn’t bother me if you are a little late.
The noise doesn’t bother her at all.

meaning_en: Eat at home or at a restaurant.
example_en: Do you want to eat in or eat out tonight?
examples_extra: We usually eat in on Fridays and order pizza.
Let's eat out tonight; there's a new restaurant nearby.
note_fa: eat in یعنی در خانه غذا خوردن، eat out یعنی رستوران رفتن.

meaning_en: To start sleeping.
example_en: I often fall asleep on the sofa.
examples_extra: The baby fell asleep in the car.
I fell asleep during the long film.

meaning_en: To give food to a person or animal.
example_en: Please feed the cat before you leave.
examples_extra: We feed the chickens every morning.
She feeds her baby at noon.
note_fa: گذشته و اسم مفعولش fed است.

meaning_en: by good luck.
example_en: Fortunately, I found my keys.
examples_extra: Fortunately, nobody was hurt in the accident.
Fortunately, the rain stopped before the match.

meaning_en: Get out of bed.
example_en: I get up at 7 AM every day.
examples_extra: I get up at seven every morning.
We all get up early on weekdays.
note_fa: یعنی از رختخواب بلند شدن؛ با wake up (بیدار شدن) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: Do an activity, often for fun or a task.
example_en: We often go swimming on Saturdays.
examples_extra: Do you want to go swimming tomorrow?
I hate going shopping on Saturdays.
note_fa: الگو: go + فعل-ing برای فعالیت‌های تفریحی.

meaning_en: To walk for pleasure or exercise.
example_en: I like to go for a walk in the park.
examples_extra: We go for a walk every evening.
She loves going for a walk in the park.

meaning_en: To leave your home to do social activities.
example_en: Let's go out for dinner tonight.
examples_extra: We go out a lot at the weekend.
Do you want to go out tonight?
note_fa: یعنی برای تفریح از خانه بیرون رفتن.

meaning_en: To lie down in bed to sleep.
example_en: I usually go to bed at 10 PM.
examples_extra: I go to bed at ten.
The children go to bed early.
note_fa: «به رختخواب رفتن»؛ go to bed late.

meaning_en: To start sleeping.
example_en: I was so tired, I went to sleep quickly.
examples_extra: I usually go to sleep at eleven.
He goes to sleep early.

meaning_en: To use the toilet.
example_en: Excuse me, I need to go to the bathroom.
examples_extra: I need to go to the bathroom.
He goes to the bathroom twice a day.

meaning_en: To travel to your job.
example_en: I go to work by car every morning.
examples_extra: I go to work by bike.
He goes to work at eight.

meaning_en: To wash your body in a bathtub.
example_en: I like to have a bath before bed.
examples_extra: She likes to have a hot bath before bed.
The baby will have a bath in the morning.
note_fa: حمام کردن؛ در آمریکا take a bath رایج‌تر است.

meaning_en: Stay awake until late at night.
example_en: I had a late night studying for my exam.
examples_extra: We will have a late night after the concert.
He may have a late night and feel tired.

meaning_en: Wash your body under running water.
example_en: I always have a shower in the morning.
examples_extra: I have a refreshing shower every single morning.
She will have a quick shower before her breakfast.
note_fa: دوش گرفتن؛ با have نه take.

meaning_en: Take a short rest or nap.
example_en: I need to have a sleep after lunch.
examples_extra: The tired baby will have a sleep upstairs.
I will have a short sleep after my lunch.

meaning_en: Clean your body with water.
example_en: I need to have a wash before dinner.
examples_extra: He will have a quick wash before his dinner.
We will all have a wash and then eat.

meaning_en: Go to bed earlier than usual.
example_en: I'm tired, so I'll have an early night.
examples_extra: I am tired, so I'll have an early night.
She will have an early night before the exam.

meaning_en: Eat the first meal of the day.
example_en: I usually have breakfast at 7 AM.
examples_extra: We have breakfast at seven every day.
She will have her breakfast in bed this morning.

meaning_en: Chores like cleaning, cooking, and washing in a house.
example_en: I do housework every Saturday.
examples_extra: She does the housework every morning.
They share the housework equally.
note_fa: با do می‌آید: do the housework.

meaning_en: Used to ask about the method or way of doing something.
example_en: How do you make this cake?
examples_extra: How do you make pancakes?
How do you spell your name?

meaning_en: Used to ask about the frequency of an action.
example_en: How often do you visit your family?
examples_extra: How often do you go swimming?
How often do you visit your parents?

meaning_en: In place of someone or something else.
example_en: I don't want coffee; I'll have tea instead.
examples_extra: She decided to order tea instead of coffee.
Let's walk instead of taking the bus.

meaning_en: The activity of making clothes smooth with an iron.
example_en: I do the ironing every Sunday.
examples_extra: The ironing took me an hour.
She does the ironing on Sundays.

meaning_en: A small, simple meal eaten at midday.
example_en: I usually have a light lunch.
examples_extra: We had a light lunch of soup and bread.
A light lunch keeps me awake in the afternoon.
note_fa: ناهار سبک؛ مثل سوپ و سالاد.

meaning_en: To pay attention to sounds.
example_en: I like to listen to music.
examples_extra: You must listen to the teacher very carefully.
I love to listen to music in the evening.

meaning_en: by good luck; fortunately.
example_en: Luckily, we found our way home.
examples_extra: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident.
Luckily, it stopped raining before noon.

meaning_en: the largest and most important meal of the day.
example_en: Dinner is usually our main meal.
examples_extra: Dinner is our main meal.
Lunch is the main meal in many countries.
note_fa: وعده اصلی روز (معمولاً ناهار یا شام).

meaning_en: Prepare the evening meal.
example_en: What are we going to make for dinner?
examples_extra: I usually make dinner at seven.
Who will make dinner tonight?

meaning_en: Tidy the bed after sleeping.
example_en: Please make the bed before you leave.
examples_extra: I make the bed daily.
She makes the bed neatly.

meaning_en: Cosmetics applied to the face.
example_en: She put on some make-up before going out.
examples_extra: She wears too much make-up.
He put on some make-up.

meaning_en: Food eaten at a regular time.
example_en: Breakfast is my favorite meal.
examples_extra: We had a delicious meal.
Dinner is the main meal.

meaning_en: In a usual or typical way.
example_en: I normally wake up at 7 am.
examples_extra: I normally walk to work, but today I took the bus.
She normally wakes up at six o'clock.

meaning_en: One time during a week, month, etc.
example_en: I go to the gym once a week.
examples_extra: We clean the house once a week.
He visits his grandmother once a month.

meaning_en: To call a friend on the phone.
example_en: I need to phone a friend for help.
examples_extra: I will phone a friend tonight.
She phoned a friend for advice.
note_fa: به دوستی زنگ زدن؛ phone somebody (بدون to).

meaning_en: To apply cosmetics to your face.
example_en: She always puts on make-up before work.
examples_extra: She puts on make-up every morning.
It takes her ten minutes to put on make-up.

meaning_en: to remove hair from your body
example_en: He shaves his beard every morning.
examples_extra: He shaves carefully with cream every single morning.
She quickly shaved her legs before the party.
note_fa: اصلاح کردن موی صورت یا پا.

meaning_en: To wash yourself using a shower.
example_en: I usually shower in the morning.
examples_extra: She showers quickly every single evening now.
He showered quickly and got dressed for work.

meaning_en: The state of resting with your eyes closed.
example_en: I need more sleep.
examples_extra: I really need more sleep tonight.
He had a deep sleep.

meaning_en: A small meal eaten between main meals.
example_en: I often eat a snack.
examples_extra: Have a snack before dinner.
We bought snacks for the trip.

meaning_en: Not always, but on some occasions.
example_en: Sometimes I walk to work.
examples_extra: I sometimes walk to work.
Sometimes she stays up late.

meaning_en: Time when you are not working.
example_en: I read books in my spare time.
examples_extra: What do you do in your spare time?
She reads a lot in her spare time.
note_fa: اوقات فراغت؛ in your spare time.

meaning_en: Remain at home; not go out.
example_en: I often stay in on cold evenings.
examples_extra: Let's stay in tonight and watch a film.
She stayed in because of the rain.
note_fa: در خانه ماندن؛ متضاد go out.

meaning_en: Do physical activity to stay healthy.
example_en: I take exercise every morning.
examples_extra: You should take more exercise.
He takes exercise every morning.

meaning_en: Wash your body with water.
example_en: I take a shower before bed.
examples_extra: I take a shower every morning.
You can take/have a shower now.

meaning_en: Food bought from a restaurant to eat elsewhere.
example_en: Let's get a Chinese takeaway tonight.
examples_extra: We had a takeaway last night.
Shall we get a takeaway?

meaning_en: most of the time; normally
example_en: I usually wake up at 7 AM.
examples_extra: I usually walk to work.
She is usually on time.
note_fa: معمولاً قبل از فعل می‌آید: I usually go.

meaning_en: To make someone stop sleeping.
example_en: My alarm clock wakes me up every morning.
examples_extra: The loud alarm will wake you up early.
Please don't wake the sleeping baby up now.

meaning_en: To stop sleeping.
example_en: I wake up at 7 AM every day.
examples_extra: What time do you usually wake up daily?
I always wake up very early indeed now.

meaning_en: To clean your clothes using water and detergent.
example_en: I need to wash clothes this weekend.
examples_extra: I wash all our clothes every Saturday.
She patiently taught him to wash his clothes.

meaning_en: (v) To clean with water; (n) the act of cleaning.
example_en: I need a quick wash before going out.
examples_extra: Please give the dirty car a good wash.
He had a quick wash and shave before dinner.

meaning_en: Dirty clothes that need to be washed.
example_en: I have a lot of washing to do today.
examples_extra: All the dirty washing is in the machine.
She hung all the washing out to dry.

meaning_en: To look at something for a period of time.
example_en: I like to watch movies on weekends.
examples_extra: We watched the beautiful sunset together yesterday.
She watches the evening news daily at six.

meaning_en: asking about the time of an action
example_en: What time do you usually wake up?
examples_extra: What time do you get up?
What time do you finish work?

meaning_en: To compose and send electronic messages.
example_en: I write emails every morning for work.
examples_extra: She writes emails every morning.
He will write emails to his clients.

meaning_en: To compose and send written messages.
example_en: My grandmother still writes letters.
examples_extra: She writes letters to her grandma.
He will write letters during the war.
